title: Gateway console user, role and MFA export
source_system: Gateway reseller console (SYS-01)

title: Gateway console settings and gateway documentation

title: Fraud filter settings and score report, Q2 2026
source_system: Gateway reseller console (SYS-01) fraud filter settings and reports
what_it_shows: Company defaults set in 2024: automatic decline at a score of 80 and above, merchant review from 60 to 79; 104 of the 120 e-commerce merchants use the defaults; about 310,000 card-not-present transactions scored in Q2 2026; the settings history shows no change to the defaults since 2024; the company sees scores, reason codes, and decline and hold counts per merchant, not the model

title: Processor partner portal users and sign-in settings

title: Residual, boarding and dispute reports, July 2025 to June 2026

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (Owner, all 7 employees, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses, including the March 2026 deposit change attempt; support staff say the keyed-entry laptops are often left unlocked at home; staff keep passwords in browser storage; the Operations Manager holds most administrator knowledge and duties; the MSP lead technician describes the remote management tool as reaching every laptop and supplied no evidence of MFA on it or of which technicians have access

title: Account comparison, 2026-07-15
source_system: Agent roster (EV-002) compared with console and CRM user lists; console and CRM sign-in logs
what_it_shows: The outside agent whose contract ended on 2026-02-13 still had active console and CRM accounts, about 5 months later; sign-in logs show no use after 2026-02-13; both accounts were disabled on 2026-07-15

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each PCI DSS requirement and Safeguards Rule element is carried out today. The MSP lead technician (2026-07-14) states the MSP runs the firewall from its own template, makes changes without the company's approval, has no written network or configuration procedures and runs no wireless scans. The Operations Manager states no penetration test has ever been done, there are no quarterly reviews, scope confirmations, change procedure or log review assignment, the 2025 phone system go-live was not reviewed as a significant change, the Operations Manager holds the office keys and has had no security training, and no acceptable use rules exist. Support staff (2026-07-15) say they were told verbally not to email card numbers and sometimes write card details on paper when a call drops; merchant PCI DSS questions are answered by email case by case; staff were not aware of the FTC notice rule; the card data found in call recordings in July 2026 was handled case by case

title: Firewall rule review, 2026-07-14
source_system: Firewall rule export and log sample, reviewed with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Rules come from the MSP's template; unsolicited inbound traffic is denied and no inbound services are published; guest Wi-Fi is separated; the default administrator password has been changed; no record of company approval for rule changes and no six-month rule review; the two support laptops share the flat staff network with all other laptops and the printer; firewall logs are kept at the MSP; intrusion prevention alerts go to the MSP only

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: Console, portal, CRM, suite and phone user lists compared with the employee and agent roster; former agent's accounts; Operations Manager and Sales and Agent Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, prohibited types, membership criteria, approvals and procedures are not documented and accounts have never been reviewed; the 4 non-owner staff hold the console role that can log in as a merchant; account use is not monitored; disabling depends on memory and the former agent's CRM and console accounts had no valid authorization from 2026-02-13 to 2026-07-15; the Sales and Agent Manager did not tell the Operations Manager when the agent contract ended; the shared phone administrator password has not changed since 2025; named users otherwise match employees and active agents; the Operations Manager and the MSP manage accounts

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Agent contract end record (2026-02-13); offboarding emails for the employee who left in 2025; MSP ticket; key log; suite admin log; Operations Manager interview
what_it_shows: No time limit for disabling access; the former agent's access lasted 5 months after exit; authenticators and MFA registrations were not revoked; no exit discussion of confidentiality duties; the employee who left in 2025 returned the laptop and office key, and that mailbox was kept with access given to the Operations Manager

title: Control assessment: MFA review and sign-in tests
source_system: Console MFA report; sign-in tests to the console (assessment test account), the phone administration page and the hosting account, with the account holders present
what_it_shows: Console administrator and support accounts for 4 of 6 users sign in with a password only; the phone administrator login and the hosting account accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: training records and interviews
source_system: Training video completion list; agent agreements; interviews with 5 employees and 2 agents
what_it_shows: All 7 employees watched the PCI awareness video at hire; the content dates from 2022 and has no privacy content on merchant owner information; agents were never trained; no training when the phone system with recording went live in 2025; no phishing simulations, reminders or call-back drills; 3 of 5 employees interviewed did not know the deposit change pretext; lessons from the March 2026 attempt are not used in training

title: Control assessment: log review examination
source_system: Console audit log; suite sign-in alerts; Operations Manager interview
what_it_shows: The console audit log records sign-ins, impersonation, refunds and settings changes and was opened for the first time during this assessment; no review of console, suite or phone logs; no reporting of review results defined; review level not changed after the March 2026 attempt or the July 2026 events

title: Control assessment: inventory and payment page content test
source_system: MSP device list; terminal spreadsheet; physical count of spare terminals; hosted payment page content export for 120 merchants
what_it_shows: The spreadsheet listed 44 spare terminals and the count found 41; the 3 units were traced to 2025 swaps shipped without an update; the spreadsheet was last reconciled in 2025; laptops and terminals are tracked by serial number with no duplicates; there is no single inventory and the phone system, website, bucket and payment page content appear in none; the page content export found third-party analytics scripts in the custom header of 2 merchants' hosted payment pages, in no company record, which the Technician had added at the merchants' request in 2025; reported to the Operations Manager and Owner on 2026-08-04

title: Control assessment: backup review
source_system: MSP backup job report (July 2026); backup retention settings; CRM vendor SOC 2 report; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: Suite user data backed up daily with 1-year retention; the July 2026 job report shows 31 of 31 successful runs; the backup service encrypts data at rest; no restore has ever been tested, as confirmed by the MSP; the backup console is administered with one MSP account without MFA and backup deletion is not prevented; the firewall configuration backup was not confirmed; the website server and bucket are not backed up by the company; security documents were kept only on the Operations Manager's laptop

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Interviews with 5 employees; ISO agreement notice clause; contact list
what_it_shows: No reporting time defined; employees interviewed would report 'when convenient' or at the next team meeting; processor partner and sponsor bank incident contacts are not recorded; staff did not know the 24-hour contract notice

title: Control assessment: incident response plan review
source_system: 2022 PCI policy template (incident section); draft POL-03 and draft P08 runbook; Owner and Operations Manager interviews
what_it_shows: No approved incident response plan at fieldwork; the draft POL-03 and draft runbook were reviewed for design; no plan had been distributed, updated or changed; the drafts sit in a restricted suite folder with edit rights limited to the Operations Manager

title: Control assessment: vulnerability scanning review
source_system: ASV reports Q3 2025 to Q2 2026; MSP patch report; Operations Manager interview
what_it_shows: Quarterly external ASV scans with standard identifiers and severity scores; the Operations Manager reviews each report and asked for a rescan in Q1 2026; the ASV tool updates its checks automatically; no internal scans and no monitoring of laptops or the website beyond MSP patching; no remediation time limits for internal findings; results are not shared beyond the Operations Manager

title: Control assessment: service provider review
source_system: ISO agreement; processor partner AOC; MSP, phone vendor, web developer and agent agreements; MSP evidence responses
what_it_shows: No security or privacy requirements in the MSP, web developer or agent agreements; no AOC from the phone vendor; no documented oversight, responsibility matrix or ongoing monitoring of providers; the MSP technician list and MFA evidence requested were not received by fieldwork end

title: Control assessment: data at rest review and test
source_system: Phone recording list and masked sample; search of support and onboarding mailboxes for card numbers and Social Security numbers; bucket object count; encryption status on 3 laptops
what_it_shows: Call recordings with spoken card data and security codes were still stored at fieldwork; 212 emails in support and onboarding mailboxes carry merchant owner Social Security numbers in attachments; 3 of 3 laptops tested are encrypted; results recorded as counts and masked samples only

title: Control assessment: patch review and test
source_system: MSP patch report (July 2026) and patch policy; patch status on 3 laptops including 1 spare; website plugin version check; firewall firmware record
what_it_shows: The MSP identifies and reports operating system and browser flaws monthly, holds updates for 7 days and checks vendor known-issue notices, and tests firewall firmware on a lab unit; the 2 spare laptops had not been patched since March 2026 because they were powered off; the website form plugin is two major versions behind; no time limits for installing security updates; no record of testing updates for effectiveness; patching is not part of a company configuration process
